response_text: The distinction between the user and the kernel in terms of what goes into which file is that user items often go into the main where they can place any function they want in order to accomplish any goal, but with calls to the kernel that would be required to fulfill and privileged requests that would require system resources or memory. The kernel, in comparison to the user, would be the most privileged code structure and code in general that would enable the user access to the resources it requests if it deems it as a valid request. In general, the distinction is important from the user perspective because it offers and abstract interface to interact with system resources that prevent misuse of said resources as regulated by the kernel mode.\n
